scheme_name: Book Allowance to the Wards of Ex-Servicemen/Widows (Sainik Welfare)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a ward of an unemployed Ex‑Serviceman or a ward of the widow of an Ex‑Serviceman
Applicant must be registered with the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry
The ward must be studying in a Government‑recognized institution
The scheme is applicable for up to two wards per unemployed Ex‑Serviceman or widow
Application must be submitted offline within three months from the date of completion of the education
benefits_summary: Provides a book allowance of ₹2,000–₹4,000 per annum depending on the level of education, reimbursed up to the actual cost of the books.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested, if required)
